description: The train's symbol (R23A, D749), its key: assigned once and never reused. crew.json's crew jobs give it as code, and the CATS train list as TRAIN_SYMBOL.
The name CATS shows on the desk train list (Route 23 AM, OCS-1).
The road number of the lead engine CATS shows (4501). Lane L4d checks it against the loco master.
The CATS font of the train's label: East or West for the direction, FONT_TRAIN for neither.
Whether a crew job runs the train in CATS (true or false, as CATS writes it).

The Operations Pro train name when it is not the symbol (D749 Return). Blank when Operations Pro names the train by its symbol. tools/audit/check_train_symbols.py checks every Operations Pro train name against the symbols and these names.
Free text for people: the train's place in the DS-01 lineup and its work.
